piece.headline: Haaland misfires, Ayodele still survives
piece.standfirst: 22 armbands on Haaland, and he scored just 2. Ayodele's lead grew anyway, while Nihal's quiet charge on second place carried on.
piece.big_picture: Haaland blanked for the captain army and still the top 2 barely flinched. Ayodele stays in front, but Nihal is now 2 off Cherag. The real title story could be the chase for second behind them.
piece.decision_of_the_week: Ravi's wrong 11 left 26 points on the bench, the biggest waste in the league. Wildcard week, so the squad was fresh. Costly timing.
piece.one_to_watch: Tobi and Isaiah are split by just 1 point on the Tin Pot line. Every point matters between them next week.

piece.headline: Ayodele wobbles and nobody pounces
piece.standfirst: Haaland gave 22 captains 4 points each, and Ayodele still stretched the lead to 11 while Nihal crept up behind.
piece.big_picture: Cherag held the crown for 6 weeks, then lost it. Ayodele had a poor week, 5 below average, and nobody punished it. Nihal is 2 behind Cherag now, so the fight for second matters. Ayodele's biggest danger may be a chaser who hasn't worn the crown yet.

title.title: The Crown Slips Away
title.text: Cherag holds the top spot on 665, but Ayodele is close behind on 657, just 8 points back. The lead has changed hands 3 times this season, and Sid sits 32 points adrift in third.

title.title: Ayodele Seizes the Crown
title.text: Ayodele overturned Cherag's lead, moving 8 points clear at 700 to 692 after Cherag had led for 6 weeks. This is Ayodele's first week on top this season, and the lead has changed hands 4 times.
title.next: Cherag could hit back quickly, and Sid sits 29 points off the lead.

title.title: Ayodele Holds the Crown
title.text: Ayodele leads on 733, 11 clear of Cherag on 722, after 2 weeks on top. Cherag held the crown for 6 weeks before losing it, and the lead has changed hands 4 times this season.
title.next: If Cherag closes the gap again, the crown could change hands once more.

title.title: Ayodele's Narrowing Lead
title.text: Ayodele leads Cherag 735 to 726, a gap of 9 that is down from 11 last week. Ayodele has held the top for 3 weeks, his first run this season, and the lead has changed hands 4 times.
title.next: 9 points. Will Cherag cut that further?

gamble:3506595:10.title: Hishaan's Bold Armband
gamble:3506595:10.text: Hishaan backed Barry as captain, a choice only one manager made, and it returned 32 points. The gamble lifted Hishaan from 14th to 8th while most managers followed Haaland, who was captained by 21.

gamble:3506595:10.title: The Armband Pays Off
gamble:3506595:10.text: Hishaan's lone Barry armband paid off with 32 points, a gamble only one manager took. The move has carried Hishaan up to 9th from 14th, while 21 managers followed Haaland.

chase:4922092.title: Ravi Closes In
chase:4922092.text: Ravi has chased Bhavik down from 32 points behind in GW7 to 14 in GW8 and then just 1 in GW9. Live in GW10, the pair are now level.

gold.title: Fight for the Gold
gold.text: Only 4 spots sit in the Gold zone, and Nihal currently holds the last one. Nanik is first out, 5 points behind, and both have spent 2 of the last 5 weeks inside the zone.

rivalry:3506595-7471754.title: Hishaan vs Tonna

underdog:573491.title: Nihal's Climb Holds
underdog:573491.text: Nihal has climbed from 26th of 29 in GW1 to 4th, and has held that spot for 2 weeks. The climb has been steady, with places gained in almost every week since GW3.
underdog:573491.next: If the climb continues, Nihal could be a serious challenger for the top 3.

underdog:573491.title: Nihal's Long Climb
underdog:573491.text: Nihal has climbed from 26th of 29 in GW1 to 3rd, a rise of 23 places. He has moved up from 4th to 3rd since last week, closer to the very top.
underdog:573491.next: If Nihal keeps climbing, he could move within touching distance of the leader.

underdog:573491.title: Nihal's Steady Climb
underdog:573491.text: Nihal holds third, 17 points off Ayodele's lead, after climbing from 26th of 29 in GW1. He has been third since GW11, and there was no move this week.
underdog:573491.next: 17 points off the top. That's the gap to watch.

chase:3506595.title: Hishaan Draws Level

chase:3506595.next: Whoever scores next could take the lead, and the chase is now in the open.

hot:1378937.next: If Edd keeps this up, a 7th straight week above average is on the cards.

hot:1378937.title: Edd Keeps Rolling
hot:1378937.text: Edd has finished above the league average 6 weeks in a row, scoring 67 in GW10. The only blip was a 49 in GW8, and the run shows no sign of stopping.
hot:1378937.next: Edd could extend the streak into a 7th week if the form holds.

slump:383423.title: Tobi's Bounce Back

slump:383423.title: Tobi Still Searching
slump:383423.text: Tobi remains below the league average after 6 weeks in a row, though 58 in GW10 was a sharp rebound from 37. The slump is still on, but the form is turning.
slump:383423.next: If Tobi builds on that 58, the run below average could finally come to an end.

fall:5873092.title: Justin's Slide Continues
fall:5873092.text: Justin has dropped from 7th in GW6 to 17th, having bottomed out at 18th in GW9. A single place back in GW10 is the first hint of a turn.
fall:5873092.next: Could Justin claw back towards the top 10, or slide further?

chase:573491.title: 2 Points Adrift

chase:573491.next: If the gap closes, Nihal could overtake Cherag for second place.

rivalry:1378937-4922092.title: Ravi Edges Ahead

rivalry:1378937-4922092.next: Edd could hit back quickly, as the gap has flipped in both directions this season.

rivalry:1378937-4922092.title: Ravi's 3-Point Grip

rivalry:1378937-4922092.next: Does Edd have one more swap left?

fall:4125292.title: Bhavik's Slide Continues
fall:4125292.text: Bhavik has dropped from 4th in GW7 to 11th now, falling a place or more every week since. His best position in that time was 4th, and the slide has not yet stopped.
fall:4125292.next: If Bhavik cannot halt the slide, he could slip further down the table.

chase:4841175.title: Maanav's Shrinking Gap
chase:4841175.text: Maanav trails Simon by 1 now, after gaps of 36 in GW9, 26 in GW10 and 3 in GW11. The gap has shrunk every week, so the chase is getting tighter.
chase:4841175.next: If Maanav's run continues, the lead could change hands soon.
